channel.title: The Assam Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: Protests, counter-slogans mark Congress visit to Batadrava Than
item.description: Congress leaders strongly condemned the protests, asserting that the visit was religious in nature and should not be politicised.

item.title: ‘Assamese or Miya?’: CM Sarma asks Congress to clarify stand under Gaurav Gogoi
item.description: CM Sarma challenges the Congress leadership to clearly state whether the party stands with indigenous Assamese interests or with the Miya community

item.title: Meghalaya mine blast: Two held, third identified as rescue ops continue
item.description: Search & rescue operations resumed on Friday at 9.55 am, with multiple agencies pressed into service amid fears that more people may still be trapped inside the mine

item.title: Assam citizens urge Gauhati HC for suo moto action on CM Sarma’s ‘Miya’ remarks
item.description: They also pointed to the CM's statements of ordering BJP workers to file objections targeting Bengali-speaking Muslims during the ongoing SR

item.title: PM Modi calls Gamosa his ‘most cherished possession’ at Pariksha Pe Charcha
item.description: Assam CM Sarma said PM Modi’s use of the Gamosa at Pariksha Pe Charcha elevates the GI-tagged handloom & honours women weavers

item.title: U-19 World Cup final: Sooryavanshi’s record knock seals India’s sixth crown
item.description: India clinched the U-19 World Cup with a dominant win over England after Sooryavanshi produced the highest individual score in a final

item.title: ACMS backs nationwide general strike against Centre’s labour reforms on February 12
item.description: The trade unions concerned have alleged that the new labour codes have created fear and uncertainty among millions of workers across the country

item.title: TIPRA Motha chief threatens legal action over alleged tribal land conversion
item.description: Calling the move a “forceful occupation”, Debbarma asserted that elections cannot be used to legitimise what he termed an unlawful takeover of tribal land

item.title: Grand preparations mark opening of Sankardev Sangha’s 95th conference at Jamugurihat
item.description: A portfolio holder of the State-level conference 9 informed that CM Sarma is expected to attend the session today

item.title: SFI holds protest in Guwahati over UGC equity bill, condemns arrest of leaders
item.description: The organization pointed out that complaints of caste-based discrimination in higher education institutions have increased significantly over the past decade
